accommodation.heading: VILLA DVORI
accommodation.p1: Would you like to enjoy a sea view from a heated swimming pool surrounded by beautiful Mediterranean gardens? The villa is composed of three independent residential units, each featuring two bedrooms, a bathroom, and a living room. It also includes a spacious, fully equipped kitchen and dining area served by its own bathroom.
accommodation.p2: It was designed to create the perfect setting for multiple families or groups of friends who wish to spend quality time together while maintaining their own privacy and personal space. All units are equipped with a TV, Wi-Fi, and air conditioning.

location.heading: LOCATION
location.subtitle: Podobuče, Pelješac, Croatia
location.description: Podobuče is a peaceful fishing village on the Pelješac peninsula — boasting two restaurants, crystal-clear water, and a wonderfully relaxed pace of life. From here, you can easily reach Korčula island by water taxi, explore the lakes and forests of Mljet National Park, sample the peninsula's famous Dingač wines, or take a scenic drive to Dubrovnik for a day in the historic Old Town.

team.label: Your Hosts
team.description: We are a family from Dubrovnik who built Villa Dvori to create the perfect holiday retreat for families and groups traveling together. Living nearby, we are always on hand to assist you — whether you need local restaurant recommendations, help organizing a boat taxi, or simply a warm welcome upon your arrival.

rules: Villa Dvori is rented exclusively as a whole property.
The minimum stay at Villa Dvori is 7 nights.
Villa Dvori is rented on a Saturday-to-Saturday basis.
The villa accommodates a maximum of 12 guests, including children and infants.
A booking deposit of 25% of the total rental price is required.
Check-in is from 16:00, check-out is before 10:00.
